SSC Selection Post 14th Exam City Details 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information :Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the Exam City Details for the Various Selection Post Phase 14th. This recruitment was released for 3003 posts. Applications for the SSC Selection Post 14th Recruitment 2026 were accepted from 13 April 2026, to 4 May 2026. The online examination is going to be conducted in August 2026. Candidates who had applied this form can download their SSC Selection Post 14th Exam City Details 2026 from the link given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 13 April 2026
  • Last Date : 04 May 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 05 May 2026
  • Form Correction Date : 11-13 May 2026
  • Exam Date : 16-26 September 2026
  • Exam City Details : 08 September 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 0/-
  • All Category Female : Rs. 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.
